_readme: THE FAILED-RUN CAUSES REGISTER — consumed by tooling/ops/triage-failed-runs.mjs.
One row per SIGNATURE (the stable part of a failing step's first error line, as derived by that
script's SIGNATURES table — never a job name). Each row names the ROOT CAUSE in one sentence taken
from the log, and the FIX: a merged SHA and PR, 'infrastructure, self-cleared', 'superseded: fixed
on the branch before merge', 'lost race under strict protection', or 'not a defect' with the reason.
A row here is HALF of an explanation. The other half — a later GREEN run of the same workflow on the
same branch, or the branch being gone — is measured live by the script and never written here. A row
with no later green is an OPEN defect and the script says so; a later green with no row is a fix
nobody can name, and the script says that too. Neither is a pass.
A trailing `*` is a prefix. Exact ids win over prefixes; the longest prefix wins among prefixes.
NO row may claim the `other:` fallback — that prefix exists so that an unrecognised failure can
never be explained by accident, and the test refuses a register that tries.
Dates are the day the fix merged. SHAs are the merge commit on main. Verified 2026-09-10 with
`git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> origin/main` for every SHA below.
Each row also carries `fixedBy`: the FIX as a typed kind a machine can check. {kind: merge, sha, pr,
also?} (pr is null for a direct push; `also` lists further merges the fix needed), {kind: superseded,
by}, {kind: infrastructure}, {kind: not-a-defect, reason}, {kind: live-action, what} or {kind:
lost-race}. The prose `fix` stays for the reader. validateCauses refuses a row whose `fixedBy` is
missing or malformed, and the live run asks `git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> origin/main` of every
merge sha before it reads the API: a sha not on main exits 1 naming its row; a shallow clone is
COVERAGE LOST (exit 2).

causes.rootCause: The [14]O-3 reader graded duty.workflow.build-platforms.yml FAILING because the newest build-platforms run on main was red (the Windows leg: the slug rename pushed one path past MAX_PATH 260, 'Unable to generate build files'), and that verdict then failed every CI run — including the ones carrying the remedy. On 2026-10-01 (ops-watch runs 36868870982 .. 36907501061) the red build-platforms run was 36864391489: on the macOS image setup-flutter ran BSD sha256sum with --check, which printed its usage and failed the SDK step.
causes.fix: PR #582 ddfc63d4 (2026-09-09, the Windows path) + PR #593 846d90a0 (2026-09-09, the verdict no longer freezes the gate its remedy needs) 2026-10-01: PR #1125 d1ae3643 checks the archive with shasum on macOS; build-platforms green on main in run 36914935790.

causes.rootCause: The [14]O-3 reader graded duty.workflow.ops-watch.yml FAILING because the newest ops-watch run on main was red (Pages freshness strict equality, the alert-disposition 403, the monitor-register drift after the subly rename), and that verdict then failed every CI run. On 2026-09-28 (ci.yml 36430039571, ops-watch 36440893650) ops-watch was red because GitHub's branch=main run listing was days stale, so the prod-provenance walker could not see the builds in production (COULD NOT LOOK), and then because the subscriptiontracker Pages deployment lagged W55. On 2026-09-30 (ops-watch run 36663623381) the red ops-watch run was 36663226147: 873 macOS minutes in billing period 2026-09 over the declared 200. On 2026-10-01 (ci.yml 36941079094, ops-watch 36943198098) the red runs were 36939849073 and 36940922904: the live auth uri_allow_list carried https://nikatru.com/app/connect and the register did not.
causes.fix: PR #593 846d90a0 (2026-09-09, self-gate removed) + PR #604 b7f268e5 (Pages freshness) + PR #607 bffae635 (alert disposition 403); 2026-09-28: PR #1041 f8700bc5 and PR #1046 00687bec (the freshness readers and the provenance walker cross-check the stale listing) 2026-09-30: PR #1078 1f348d8c (a dated 2026-09 macOS exception); 2026-10-02: PR #1138 f6c1aa4a (the register records /app/connect).

causes.rootCause: The laptop backup's newest SUCCESSFUL heartbeat fell outside its 12h window: the backup refused to sync because the subly rename deleted more paths than its --max-delete threshold allows. On 2026-09-28 (ops-watch runs 36412378353, 36412660595, 36413994725) the newest successful beat again fell outside the 12h window; this duty pages, it does not change the tree. On 2026-09-29 (ops-watch runs 36608990647 .. 36633453785; newest beat 05:45:07Z) the laptop was being moved to a new machine (archived 2026-09-29 17:54 IST, restored from 2026-09-30 01:42 IST; its routines resumed at 2026-09-29T21:19Z), so the 8h task did not run. On 2026-10-02 (runs 36949946104, 36952541569; newest beat 2026-10-01 13:02:38Z) the 02:02 IST run (backup-offsite-20261002-020223.log) ended in "rclone copy failed for 'platform repo' (7)": files of a live lane's scratch copy under Projects/.lead-state/scratch changed while rclone copied them ("corrupted on transfer", "failed to open source object").
causes.fix: not a defect in the tree: owner-authorised sync on 2026-09-09; heartbeat resumed 18:31:46Z (GlitchTip monitor 6); 2026-09-28: the backup was re-run at 10:58Z and succeeded, and its beat was read fresh on the next ops-watch 2026-09-29: the restore resumed the routines and the task beat again; 2026-10-02: the 06:58 IST run copied cleanly and beat again (no change to the tree either time).

fixedBy.reason: an owner-authorised sync paused the beat; it resumed with no change to the tree
